name: Public Records — Phone Number Validator: E.164 Format, Country & Line Type to HTTP
author: Public Records
description: Run publicrecords/phone-number-validator on YOUR Apify account via HTTP, then use the rows in later modules. Set APIFY_TOKEN in a Make connection or variable. Do not hard-code a token. Official Make gallery submission is not included.

metadata.notes: Rebuild in Make with the HTTP module if import of this blueprint is rejected; the URL, method, header and body are the recipe.
